newsitem.title: USA: Happiness Express top executive resigns.
newsitem.headline: Happiness Express top executive resigns.

text.p: Happiness Express Inc said on Tuesday that Joseph Sutton resigned as the company's chief executive officer, president and chairman.
Sutton's resignation was accepted by the company on September 27.

In addition, a committee of independent directors was formed to conduct a previously announced investigation into financial irregularities at the company and manage its operations pending the results of the probe.
Morton Scheer, Arthur Golden and Sheldon Hirsch will serve on the committee, the company said.
On September 25, Isaac Sutton was terminated as executive vice president and chief operating officer, Happiness Express said.
